The computational scheduling system must adhere to fundamental operational principles governing investigation execution and resource allocation. Within each individual investigation, a strict sequential processing protocol requires that computational phases occur in their predetermined order, ensuring that no subsequent phase may begin until the previous phase has been fully completed. Simultaneously, the resource exclusivity principle mandates that each computational node can accommodate only one phase at any given moment, which prevents temporal overlap between phases regardless of their investigation origin. The facility management seeks to determine optimal temporal positioning for all computational phases, aiming to minimize the makespan - calculated as the maximum completion time across all investigations - thereby achieving superior computational resource utilization and reducing the overall research timeline to its optimal duration.

from ortools.sat.python import cp_model
import itertools
import json

def create_job_shop_scheduling():
    """Create and solve the job shop scheduling problem."""
    
    investigations = ['Alpha', 'Beta', 'Gamma', 'Delta', 'Epsilon', 'Zeta', 'Eta', 'Theta', 
                     'Iota', 'Kappa', 'Lambda', 'Mu', 'Nu', 'Xi', 'Omicron']
    nodes = list(range(1, 16))
    phases = list(range(1, 16))
    
    node_assignment = {
        'Alpha': [7, 13, 5, 8, 4, 3, 11, 12, 9, 15, 10, 14, 6, 1, 2],
        'Beta': [5, 6, 8, 15, 14, 9, 12, 10, 7, 11, 1, 4, 13, 2, 3],
        'Gamma': [2, 9, 10, 13, 7, 12, 14, 6, 1, 3, 8, 11, 5, 4, 15],
        'Delta': [6, 3, 10, 7, 11, 1, 14, 5, 8, 15, 12, 9, 13, 2, 4],
        'Epsilon': [8, 9, 7, 11, 5, 10, 3, 15, 13, 6, 2, 14, 12, 1, 4],
        'Zeta': [6, 4, 13, 14, 12, 5, 15, 8, 3, 2, 11, 1, 10, 9, 7],
        'Eta': [13, 4, 8, 9, 15, 7, 2, 12, 5, 6, 3, 11, 1, 14, 10],
        'Theta': [12, 6, 1, 8, 13, 14, 15, 2, 3, 9, 5, 4, 10, 7, 11],
        'Iota': [11, 12, 7, 15, 1, 2, 3, 6, 13, 5, 9, 8, 10, 14, 4],
        'Kappa': [7, 12, 10, 3, 9, 1, 14, 4, 11, 8, 2, 13, 15, 5, 6],
        'Lambda': [5, 8, 14, 1, 6, 13, 7, 9, 15, 11, 4, 2, 12, 10, 3],
        'Mu': [13, 4, 11, 9, 5, 8, 7, 10, 6, 3, 2, 15, 12, 1, 14],
        'Nu': [9, 14, 11, 3, 4, 7, 10, 1, 12, 2, 5, 6, 8, 15, 13],
        'Xi': [3, 6, 5, 4, 10, 2, 12, 14, 8, 7, 11, 15, 1, 9, 13],
        'Omicron': [11, 9, 13, 7, 5, 2, 14, 15, 12, 1, 8, 4, 3, 10, 6]
    }
    
    processing_time = {
        'Alpha': [94, 66, 10, 53, 26, 15, 65, 82, 10, 27, 93, 92, 96, 70, 83],
        'Beta': [74, 31, 88, 51, 57, 78, 8, 7, 91, 79, 18, 51, 18, 99, 33],
        'Gamma': [4, 82, 40, 86, 50, 54, 21, 6, 54, 68, 82, 20, 39, 35, 68],
        'Delta': [73, 23, 30, 30, 53, 94, 58, 93, 32, 91, 30, 56, 27, 92, 9],
        'Epsilon': [78, 23, 21, 60, 36, 29, 95, 99, 79, 76, 93, 42, 52, 42, 96],
        'Zeta': [29, 61, 88, 70, 16, 31, 65, 83, 78, 26, 50, 87, 62, 14, 30],
        'Eta': [18, 75, 20, 4, 91, 68, 19, 54, 85, 73, 43, 24, 37, 87, 66],
        'Theta': [32, 52, 9, 49, 61, 35, 99, 62, 6, 62, 7, 80, 3, 57, 7],
        'Iota': [85, 30, 96, 91, 13, 87, 82, 83, 78, 56, 85, 8, 66, 88, 15],
        'Kappa': [5, 59, 30, 60, 41, 17, 66, 89, 78, 88, 69, 45, 82, 6, 13],
        'Lambda': [90, 27, 1, 8, 91, 80, 89, 49, 32, 28, 90, 93, 6, 35, 73],
        'Mu': [47, 43, 75, 8, 51, 3, 84, 34, 28, 60, 69, 45, 67, 58, 87],
        'Nu': [65, 62, 97, 20, 31, 33, 33, 77, 50, 80, 48, 90, 75, 96, 44],
        'Xi': [28, 21, 51, 75, 17, 89, 59, 56, 63, 18, 17, 30, 16, 7, 35],
        'Omicron': [57, 16, 42, 34, 37, 26, 68, 73, 5, 8, 12, 87, 83, 20, 97]
    }
    
    model = cp_model.CpModel()
    
    total_processing_time = 0
    for i in investigations:
        total_processing_time += sum(processing_time[i])
    
    start_time = {}
    for i in investigations:
        for p in phases:
            start_time[(i, p)] = model.NewIntVar(0, total_processing_time, f'start_{i}_{p}')
    
    makespan = model.NewIntVar(0, total_processing_time, 'makespan')
    
    for i in investigations:
        for p in range(1, 15):
            model.Add(start_time[(i, p+1)] >= start_time[(i, p)] + processing_time[i][p-1])
    
    phases_by_node = {n: [] for n in nodes}
    for i in investigations:
        for p in phases:
            node = node_assignment[i][p-1]
            phases_by_node[node].append((i, p))
    
    for node in nodes:
        node_phases = phases_by_node[node]
        for idx1, (i1, p1) in enumerate(node_phases):
            for idx2, (i2, p2) in enumerate(node_phases):
                if idx1 < idx2:
                    precedes = model.NewBoolVar(f'precedes_{i1}_{p1}_{i2}_{p2}')
                    
                    duration1 = processing_time[i1][p1-1]
                    duration2 = processing_time[i2][p2-1]
                    
                    model.Add(start_time[(i1, p1)] + duration1 <= start_time[(i2, p2)]).OnlyEnforceIf(precedes)
                    
                    model.Add(start_time[(i2, p2)] + duration2 <= start_time[(i1, p1)]).OnlyEnforceIf(precedes.Not())
    
    for i in investigations:
        last_phase = 15
        model.Add(start_time[(i, last_phase)] + processing_time[i][last_phase-1] <= makespan)
    
    model.Minimize(makespan)
    
    solver = cp_model.CpSolver()
    solver.parameters.max_time_in_seconds = 300.0
    solver.parameters.num_search_workers = 8
    
    status = solver.Solve(model)
    
    if status in (cp_model.OPTIMAL, cp_model.FEASIBLE):
        phase_initiation_times = []
        for i in investigations:
            phase_times = [solver.Value(start_time[(i, p)]) for p in phases]
            phase_initiation_times.append(phase_times)
        research_completion_duration = solver.Value(makespan)
    else:
        phase_initiation_times = []
        research_completion_duration = 0

    print(json.dumps({
        "phase_initiation_times": phase_initiation_times,
        "research_completion_duration": research_completion_duration
    }))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    create_job_shop_scheduling()
